design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER task 0 (disclosures_conditions_and_application_fees, category loan). Step 0 draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]} -> prerequisite loan_ext_credit_report_repull_fee takes 5 factors, root loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs takes 4 (round 2 swapped the assignment: round 1 gave the root 5, two of which the audit struck).

ROUND 2 REVISION LOG. (F-2) closing_package_redraw dropped: its middle tier reschedule_fee is 0.00 for every closing method, equal to the fall-through. (F-4a) report_line_source dropped as a factor: its estimate tier negated the root's own prerequisite; the credit report line is now a plain read (booked charges less than one month old) and remains the gate of the value_input edge. Added to the root: closing_service_line (method, cross funding: new Mobile Notary/RON closing opened after the latest Closing Disclosure -> method fee, plus after-hours fee for a weekend Mobile Notary signing). title_bringdown became a method factor (new commitment priced per thousand of base loan / flat date-down / nothing; new-commitment age raised to 180 days, the usual commitment life). Added to the repull: inquiry_supplement (credit inquiry explanation conditions -> credit supplement). Seed: the 2026-10-09 Traditional Wet closing is cancelled and a Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing (opened 2026-10-09, signing Friday 2026-10-30) is scheduled; a credit inquiry explanation condition (issued 2026-07-15, cleared 2026-07-22) was added. Values moved: repull 48.26 -> 60.76, corrected figure 7338.61 -> 7376.11; every proof field below was recomputed with the charter compute (scratch evaluator), not by hand.

WHY A GOOD TEST: the borrower asks only for a corrected Closing Disclosure for a closing she moved to 2026-10-30. The corrected figure waits on a credit report charge still valid on that date; the only charge (2026-06-12) will be 140 days old. The agent must find that on the fee ledger, see from the repull rule that a new pull is the borrower's own authorization and payment, price it (five factors over the fee ledger, the closing date, the conditions and the lock extension ledger), hand it over, and then restate the figure from four more factors (appraisal age, title age, employment verification age, the newly scheduled closing). One tool per problem, so the difficulty is reading and arithmetic.

SCOPE: task 0 = {loan_ext_credit_report_repull_fee (loan_credit_report_fee_charged, user tool authorize_credit_report_repull_408eaf54), loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs (loan_cd_corrected, agent tool issue_corrected_closing_disclosure_de3eb1f4)}. Task 1 = application fee, revised Loan Estimate, zero-tolerance cure, initial Closing Disclosure; disjoint.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs <- loan_ext_credit_report_repull_fee, value_input, gate credit_report_line, state form. Sentence (affirmative, how a disclosure desk says a figure rests on what it is built from): 'The nonrecurring closing costs on a corrected Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the file's fee ledger carries a credit report fee charge whose report is still within the credit report validity window on the scheduled closing date.' Four-point test: 'only after'; record-visible state (a fee-ledger charge and its age against the scheduled closing date); no tool/id/code token; scope = condition. Only the repull policy books loan_credit_report_fee_charged in this difficulty. Opening evidence: initial_state.loan_fee_ledger.132f6db6-1274-4175-9643-94788d23e337.entry_date = 2026-06-12 -> 140 days on 2026-10-30 > 120. Resolver owner user. Order: repull (step 9) then corrected Closing Disclosure (step 15). Deletion run: skipping the repull gives 7315.35 instead of 7376.11. user_scenario names no prerequisite; neither tool checks anything.

FACTOR CARD loan_ext_credit_report_repull_fee (baseline: program price 92.40 x 2 borrowers, no delivery fee, no supplement, borrower pays all = 184.80): repull_unit_price 61.80 (charge 4 months old) -> 82.18 if missed; joint_bundle (method) 61.80 x 1.40 = 86.52 -> 79.30; closing_delivery_speed 10.00 (16 days) -> 55.76; inquiry_supplement 25.00 (one credit inquiry explanation condition 639c1987-b000-4bbc-9f50-ca5e477b3b4d) -> 48.26; delay_bearer_share 0.50 (cross lock, multi-source: Larkspur 5 days vs borrower 20) -> 121.52. Near-miss: the 2026-10-02 extension is wholly Larkspur-borne (cost 0.00); counting only the latest entries or only cost would mis-tier the share. Result (86.52 + 10.00 + 25.00) x 0.50 = 60.76.

FACTOR CARD loan_ext_corrected_cd_nonrecurring_costs (baseline, round 3 wording: the latest Closing Disclosure's 6842.35 carried forward plus the credit report charges booked less than one month before the issue date, 60.76 = 6903.11, which is also the all-factors-at-baseline figure): appraisal_recertification 175.00 (inspected 2026-06-25, 127 days) -> 7201.11 if missed; title_bringdown (method) date-down 75.00 (commitment 100 days old) -> 7301.11; employment_reverification 24.00 x 2 = 48.00 (29 days) -> 7328.11; closing_service_line (method, cross funding, multi-source: opened after the CD AND method AND weekday) 175.00 -> 7201.11. Near-misses: completed_date 2026-07-06 (116 days) would wrongly fall inside validity — the rule measures from inspection; the cancelled Traditional Wet closing is not the closing now scheduled; a weekend signing would add the 75.00 after-hours fee but 2026-10-30 is a Friday. Result 6842.35 + 60.76 + 175 + 75 + 48 + 175 = 7376.11.

LADDER LIVENESS (class sweep, round 2): every tier of both policies can hold at the write's own handling time once the prerequisite holds — the repull's tiers depend on charge ages, borrower counts, closing distance, condition counts and lock days; the corrected figure's tiers depend on appraisal/title/verification ages and the scheduled closing, none of which the prerequisite fixes. No two tiers of a ladder select the same value or method. (The appraisal ladder's middle tier is empty only for a report type whose max_age_with_update_days is below validity_days, i.e. the Desktop report; it is live for every other report type.)

BASE-INVARIANT CARD: loan_agg_shared_credit_report report_window_lapsed (time): anchor 2026-06-12 (customer's latest charge), 120 calendar days, day zero = entry date, not_before, exclusive -> chargeable from 2026-10-11; frozen 2026-10-14 satisfies it (2026-10-10 would wait). The overwrite replaces only the fee sentence; window and 'never refunded' stay inherited. loan_cd_corrected: loan_closing_disclosure_timing gates bind consummation only -> policy_scope; APR, program and prepayment terms do not change, so no new waiting period.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: loan file 59070ceb-15c1-4c29-98d1-2bfbe347ac1a; credit report evidence = loan_credit_report_fee_charged rows of this file (application-fee row excluded by event type); lock = the customer's one lock and its three extension rows; appraisal = the single standard order; conditions = cleared title commitment, cleared VVOE, the issued credit inquiry explanation; closing = the scheduled Mobile Notary closing 0a50b212-9dbf-4d89-8220-d9ea99d54667 (the cancelled 30c75b59-2d39-41f1-8494-0c8a7e4f5634 excluded by status). The corrected Closing Disclosure carries sequence 2 after the 2026-10-02 Closing Disclosure.

SEED and automatic clauses: lock covers 2026-10-30 (expires 2026-11-02); no condition overdue; Closing Disclosure 1 zero-tolerance total equals the revised Loan Estimate baseline, so no cure is owed; the cancelled closing and the new closing are states the funding charter produces (method change = cancel and reschedule).

PERSONA: brisk organized buyer; volunteers only the moved closing and the title company's request; phone + SSN4 on request; states the request date, two borrowers and the mobile-notary signing only when asked; cooperates with any personal step after hearing the amount; pays by Visa credit card; ends when told the corrected disclosure is issued.

STANDARD SOLUTION: locate/verify; read loan file, disclosures, fee ledger, lock, extensions, request log; hand the 60.76 repull to Renata (borrower_count 2, credit_card); read appraisal order and charges, conditions, closings; issue corrected Closing Disclosure sequence 2, borrower_requested_change documented 2026-10-09, nonrecurring 7376.11.

ROUND 3: (N-2) the closing service ladder's middle tier now reads 'a Mobile Notary Closing signing on a weekday, or a Remote Online Notarization Closing signing on any day', matching the compute, so a weekend RON signing has a rule outcome (closing_method_fee only; RON has no after-hours fee). (O-11) the credit report line is folded into the baseline paragraph, so baseline.rule and the all-factors-at-baseline figure agree (6903.11). (Class sweep) repull report bundle: the individual-report tier now also covers a file that has shrunk to a single borrower, the only compute branch that had no rule tier; the corrected Closing Disclosure tool's enum text no longer carries an example ('such as a new closing date') that matched this task's gold. No scored value of this task changed (60.76 / 7376.11).

ROUND 4: (N-3) the closing service ladder now partitions on the opening date exactly as the compute does — 'opened on a date later than the issue date of the latest Closing Disclosure' for the two fee tiers and 'opened on or before that issue date, or of any other method, or no closing in scheduled status' for nothing — and the compute no longer fails when the file has no closing in scheduled status (O-13). (N-4) the repull rule says a zero delay share books the charge at 0.00 and the repull tool's contract now accepts 0.00. (Render item 1) the repull overwrite's replacement names its scope ('for a credit report pulled again on an existing loan file at the borrower's authorization, and only for such a repull') and keeps the base fee for every other pull outside the window, including the first pull on a new file. (Render item 5) the appraisal ladder's new-appraisal tier now requires the report to be older than both validity_days and max_age_with_update_days, so the Desktop report type (no update allowed) no longer overlaps the 'nothing' tier. No scored value changed (60.76 / 7376.11).

ROUND 5: the appraisal update line now reads the file's standard appraisal order in delivered status (nothing is added where there is none), the same record the compute selects. No scored value changed.

ROUND 6: (N-5 class) every record read is now the one record the rule names, proved by decoy probes on scratch copies of this world (cancelled standard appraisal order, an older-document title commitment cleared later, an earlier VVOE, a cancelled RON closing, a same-date lower-sequence Closing Disclosure — each stored first; the corrected figure stays 7376.11 in every probe): the latest Closing Disclosure is the one with the highest disclosure sequence, the title and VVOE ages use the most recent document / resolved date among the cleared conditions, the appraisal is the file's standard order in delivered status, the closing is the file's closing in scheduled status. No scored value changed.

ROUND 7: (N-6 class) every read now has a stated, computed outcome when its record is absent — no primary appraisal order in delivered status, no cleared title commitment, no cleared verbal verification yet, no closing in scheduled status, no Closing Disclosure, no scheduled closing date, no earlier credit report charge, no lock extension, no inquiry condition — each probed on a scratch copy of this world (worklog, Round 7 table); the corrected Closing Disclosure now reads the file's primary appraisal order (standard_order, transferred_in or new_order_after_expiration) in delivered status. No scored value changed.

ROUND 8: the corrected Closing Disclosure's appraisal, title and verification lines now name the no-scheduled-closing-date case (nothing added) that the compute already gave; the delivered_order binding moved into the appraisal factor that alone reads it; the repull rule states that an extension whose cost Larkspur later waived still counts by the days its own entry records (probe: a 1236.00 waiver leaves the repull at 60.76). No scored value changed.

VERIFICATION: check_compute.py --task 0 recomputes both values at handling time, each factor's baseline and the whole baseline listed in computations, and the skip of step 9 (7315.35). All proof figures above were produced by running the charter compute on the replayed worlds.
user_scenario: You are Renata Iverson, a 39-year-old operations manager in Columbus, Ohio, buying the house at 3418 Kenwood Bluff Drive with your husband Tomas through Larkspur Home Lending. You are organized and a little tired of paperwork, polite but brisk, and you like to hear numbers read back clearly. You open by explaining that your closing was supposed to be October 9th, but last Friday you asked your loan officer to push it to October 30th because the movers and your lease end lined up better, and Kestrel Title Agency told you that with the new date you will need a corrected Closing Disclosure from Larkspur. You want Larkspur to prepare and send you that corrected Closing Disclosure for the October 30th closing today, and you are happy for the agent to issue it for you. You do not know what goes into it and you do not ask about any particular fee. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your phone number 6145553182 and, if a second item is needed, the last four of your Social Security number, 4718; only if they ask for something else do you give your date of birth, April 9, 1987, or your ZIP code 43220. If the agent asks when you asked to move the closing, you say you called your loan officer on Friday, October 9th, 2026. If the agent asks how you will sign, you say the title company is sending a mobile notary to your office on the 30th. If the agent asks how many people are on the loan, you say two, you and Tomas, and that Tomas is not on this call but you handle the loan paperwork for both of you. If the agent explains that something has to be authorized or paid by you personally before the corrected disclosure can be prepared, you say that is fine as long as they tell you the exact amount first; once the agent hands that step to you, you run it yourself with the details the agent reads out, paying on your Visa credit card, and you read back whatever confirmation it shows. If the agent tells you an amount for that step, you accept it without arguing and do not try to work it out yourself. If the agent says the corrected Closing Disclosure has been issued and will be in your e-sign portal, you thank them, say you will look for it there tonight, and end the call.
